Dear Barbora,

Today's all about you, and I wanted to make it a little brighter with something just for you.

Nothing fancy or expensive, but something real made with the hope it puts a smile on your face and stays with you as a memory.

And honestly, it's not only about the birthday.

It's a way of saying thank you for being the warm kind person who makes happiness look effortless, for always being there for me and for sharing your light with me.

I'm genuinely excited to spend this day with you. Don't bring a single thing with you, just yourself is already more than enough.

Happy birthday ya 7bbty. May there be many more birthdays and to always getting to spend them side by side.
